neighborhoods.name: Sompting
neighborhoods.notes: village centre with conservation elements; St Mary the Virgin Church area

property_mix.notable: Sompting is a commuter village with significant 1930s–1960s suburban growth; proximity to Lancing College influences character

locksmith_relevant: Sompting's mix of older Victorian properties and mid-century bungalows means varied lock mechanisms—period sash windows and original timber doors are common.
High proportion of semi-detached homes built 1920s–1960s often have worn original locks and modest security; PVCu door replacements increasingly need modern cylinder upgrades.
Proximity to A27 and railway makes this a commuter base; many residents need reliable rekeying and spare key services for second homes and rental properties.
